title: Every merge to the main branch uploads a Worker version addressable at a stable preview alias URL
description: The CI pipeline runs a build+upload step on every merge to the main branch. The step produces an uploaded Worker version (the vendor's version primitive) with two addressable URLs recorded on the CI run: a permanent per-version-id URL, and a stable ALIAS URL fixed to the string `main` (or an equivalent operator-chosen alias) that always resolves to the newest-of-main upload. The alias URL never changes across re-uploads; the version-id URL is unique per upload and durable. The uploaded version does NOT serve production traffic; it exists only at the preview URLs until an explicit promote step runs. The version id and both URLs are surfaced in the CI run output.
rationale: Uploading a version on merge without promoting it separates two concerns most teams tangle at their cost: 'is the artefact built and cleanly uploaded' from 'is production serving it now'. The stable preview alias URL is the shape a stakeholder can bookmark and share; the version-id URL is the shape a change-review workflow references verbatim. Both matter and both come from the same upload step.
